data.standardized_narrative: In 2021, Syndicate 2623 reported a gross prior year reserve release of $150.8 million, representing a 3.5% reduction in opening gross claims outstanding. This release was primarily driven by favorable claims development across the 2019 underwriting year, despite impacts from COVID-19 and natural catastrophes like Hurricanes Laura, Sally, Delta, Zeta, Storm Dorian, Typhoons Faxai, and Hagibis. The 2020 underwriting year was adversely affected by COVID-19 claims in the contingency book and an increase in ransomware claims, but overall prior year releases were achieved. A significant contribution to the release came from a Loss Portfolio Transfer in the Property division's Engineering classes.
